text:
jess: quick notewe've been getting reports from the Next edge sample and a couple of Cloudflare worker demos after yesterday's SDK release. error is ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED when they import 'redwood-inference'.

omar: ack. which change caused it?

jess: i simplified package.exports to only have import/require entries, like:
```json
\"exports\": {\n  \".\": {\n    \"import\": \"./dist/index.mjs\",\n    \"require\": \"./dist/index.cjs\"\n  }\n}\n```

priya: that usually works but edge runtimes + some bundlers differ in condition resolution. next dev (edge) sometimes resolves to require path and then node's resolver complains if default export isn't available or subpath not exposed.

noah: also typescript consumers reported missing declarations for certain import scenarios. our "types" field points at dist/index.d.ts but TS resolution can consult exports and fail to map types to conditions.

jess: repro steps i added to the sample app: create middleware with `export default function` that imports SDK via `import SDK from 'redwood-inference'` -> `next dev` crashes with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.

omar: short-term: publish a patch with a more compatible export map and add main/module back. proposal:
```json
\"exports\": {\n  \".\": {\n    \"edge\": \"./dist/edge.mjs\",\n    \"import\": \"./dist/index.mjs\",\n    \"require\": \"./dist/interop.cjs\",\n    \"default\": \"./dist/index.cjs\"\n  },\n  \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\"\n},\n\"main\": \"./dist/index.cjs\",\n\"module\": \"./dist/index.mjs\",\n\"types\": \"./dist/index.d.ts\"\n```

priya: agree. interop.cjs should be a tiny wrapper that normalizes default export for CJS consumers: `module.exports = require('./index.cjs').default || require('./index.cjs')` so bundlers that expect CJS get a proper value. also add a `types` conditional in exports: `\"types\": \"./dist/index.d.ts\"` under the dot key to help bundlers that look there.

build-bot: created draft PR #158 with those changes and runs CI matrix (node 16/18, ts 4.9/5.2).

noah: long-term suggestions: add a small compatibility test suite that runs the sample apps (next edge, vercel edge, cloudflare worker, deno) in CI for any PR touching package.json or build pipeline. also add a PR checklist item: export map changes require compatibility notes and semver bump.

jess: i'll pin the sample apps to the PR branch for testing and ping early adopters. thanks team for the quick loop. we'll post a short upgrade note in the changelog once the patch is published.
